subject: Recovery flightplan & SIG onboarding — next steps
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@zenledger.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: zenledger-sig@sig.org
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: recovery artifacts + witness plan for SIG intake

Hi Hannah,

Hope you’re well — we’re kicking off the SIG intake for the ZenLedger evaluation and need a concise set of BCP/DR artifacts we can review prior to scheduling a live witness. Specifically the SIG team asked for: a short (1–2 page) recovery summary that maps RTO/RPO to service tiers, the latest runbook excerpt showing failover steps for the inference control plane, and any tabletop slide deck you use for live demonstrations.

Can you confirm what you can share this week? We’d like the artifacts in Drive and propose a 45-minute witness call the week of Aug 25 to walk through the tabletop and ask a few clarifying questions. Once we have the artifacts we will create the SIG intake packet and confirm the witness window.

Also: will you be able to provide a contact who can walk through the runbook and answer technical recovery questions during the witness?

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Security Assurance — ZenLedger
Attachments: none

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@zenledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: recovery artifacts + witness plan for SIG intake

Hi Claire — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the requested artifacts this week. Summary of what I’m attaching and next steps below:

Artifacts (attached / in Drive):
- recovery-flightplan-v1.pdf — 2-page executive recovery flightplan mapping RTO/RPO by service tier (hosted API, dedicated, private).
- runbook-excerpt-2025-08.txt — trimmed excerpt showing the primary failover play for the inference control plane and cache warm procedures.
- tabletop-witness-slides.pptx — a short deck we use for live walks (timeline, roles, triggers, failback).

Proposed witness slots (all PT):
- Tue Aug 26, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Aug 27, 13:00–13:45
- Thu Aug 28, 08:30–09:15

Ben (ops) will be the primary runbook walkthrough lead and Monica will handle the executive context and service-tier RTO/RPO mapping. Hope one of those slots works — if not, share your preferred times and we’ll accommodate.

Quick note on redactions: the runbook excerpt contains some internal hostnames; we’ve sanitized DNS values and replaced exact S3 bucket names with placeholders in the attached text file. If SIG requires an unredacted view for the live witness, we can do that on the call under an NDA-friendly screen-share protocol.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference, Inc.
Attachments: recovery-flightplan-v1.pdf (PDF), runbook-excerpt-2025-08.txt (text), tabletop-witness-slides.pptx (PPTX)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@zenledger.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 09:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: recovery artifacts + witness plan for SIG intake

Claire / Hannah — adding a quick technical note ahead of the witness:

Quoted excerpt from runbook-excerpt-2025-08.txt (for context):

"On detection of regional GPU node loss (>= 50% node failure for pool A):
1) Shift routing policy to Dedicated fallback pool B (automated, ~30s).
2) Initiate KV cache repopulation via warm-start job using last-known prefixes (expected cache warm latency: 8–12s for 95th perc).
3) Trigger autoscaler spin-up of pre-warmed instances in adjacent AZs (target capacity in 3–5 minutes).
4) If SLA tier is Premium, route to hot-standby in alternate region (RTO target: 3 minutes).

Failback: monitor error-rate and throughput for 30 minutes before shifting traffic back; validate checkpoint consistency before full cutover."

I’ll be on the witness call and can demonstrate the simulated failover in our staging environment (we use a controlled node kill and live traffic replay). If SIG wants logs showing previous tabletop runs, I can attach a short trace extract — let me know.

Ben Carter
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@zenledger.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: zenledger-sig@sig.org
Date: Sun, 24 Aug 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: recovery artifacts + witness plan for SIG intake

Thanks — this looks good. We reviewed the Drive artifacts and the sanitized runbook excerpt is sufficient for the intake packet. Please consider the witness confirmed for Tue Aug 26, 10:00–10:45 PT. The SIG observers will include two reviewers and one technical witness.

For the call we’ll need:
- A brief 5–7 minute exec overview covering service tiers and RTO/RPO mapping (Monica)
- A 20–25 minute runbook walk and simulated failover (Ben)
- 10–15 minutes of Q&A.

Also please upload the trace extract Ben mentioned if available (helps expedite technical review). We’ll exchange an access-limited Drive link once the intake packet is prepared.

Claire Zhang
Security Assurance — ZenLedger
Attachments: none
